title: Book Three · Chapter 99: When the Group Returns
story:
At a little after one, the visit group returns to the library.

Anna walks beside a woman with a rolled drawing. She is talking and pointing to a page in her notebook.

Then she sees Ronan by the wall. Her hand stops above the page.

He stands up.

“Anna.”

She thanks the woman and comes toward him. She keeps the notebook against her bag.

“You missed it,” she says.

“The man was late.”

“Which man?”

Ronan looks down at his full bottle.

“A customer. He wanted six books. I said I would give them to him at half past eight.”

“You didn't tell me.”

“I thought it would take five minutes.”

Anna looks toward the library doors. The guide is saying goodbye to the last people.

“I waited until a quarter past. Kai brought your note. It said you were coming.”

“I wanted to.”

“Leo was at the table.”

Ronan nods. “Yes.”

“He could give the books to the man.”

“Yes.”

She waits. Ronan has no useful next sentence.

He takes a breath.

“He offered. I stayed. Then I kept selling after the first bus left.”

Anna's eyes move to his face.

“All morning?”

“Until eleven.”

For a moment, neither speaks. A child comes through the doors with his mother. They pass between the two students and go down the steps.

Anna moves aside for them. Ronan stays by the wall.

“Was the visit good?” he asks.

“Yes. The man answered my question. I saw the models and the plans.”

He looks at her notebook.

“I wanted you to hear the answer too,” she says. “I saved the place for you.”

“I'm sorry.”

“You said nine.”

“I know.”

She holds the notebook more tightly.

Ronan reaches a little toward her hand. She keeps both hands on her bag, and he stops.

“I can walk you home.”

“I want to walk alone.”

He nods and steps back.

Anna goes along the library road. She does not look back at the corner. Ronan stays until she is out of sight.

Then he takes his own road home.

Mum is putting a finished coat away when he comes in.

“The visit?” she asks.

“I didn't go. I stayed with the books.”

She looks at him for a moment. Then she moves his school things away from her work and leaves space at the table.

Ronan sits down. His bus money is still in the personal envelope. He takes out the visit sheet, with both names on it, and puts it beside the closed cash book.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

rolled drawing＝卷起的图纸；offer＝提出愿意做；tightly＝紧紧地；out of sight＝看不见了。

## 理解问题

1. Anna有没有按计划参观？她原本想和Ronan共同经历什么？
2. Ronan有没有一直只说“顾客迟到”？他后来明确承认了哪两个选择？

## 读句子

**She keeps both hands on her bag, and he stops.**

拆开看：She / keeps both hands on her bag, / and he stops.

她／把双手都放在包上／他便停下了伸手的动作。
